faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Trichy JRF/Project Associate-1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech degree with first class in specific circuit branches from a UGC recognized university. GATE qualification is mandatory for the JRF position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any preference for higher qualifications?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have completed M.E/M.Tech in Biomedical/Instrumentation/Allied Circuit Branches with a first-class grade.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is 32 years. However, age relaxations are provided for SC/ST and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Certainly, SC/ST candidates can avail a 5-year age relaxation, and OBC candidates can avail a 3-year age relaxation from the upper age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF and Project Associate-1 positions?
faq.answer: For GATE-qualified candidates (JRF), the salary is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA for the third year. For non-GATE candidates (Project Associate-1), it is Rs. 30,000/-+HRA for the first two years and Rs. 33,000/- + HRA for the third year.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. They must send their duly filled application along with all necessary documents as a single PDF to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening and shortlisting of applications, followed by an offline interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of their educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with their application.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
